quote: Mu'ammar al-Qadhdhafi denies reports that the Soviet Union has any rights to bases in his country.

summary: A July 1976 compilation of Libyan radio and news agency items in which Qadhdhafi attacks Egyptian President Sadat, threatens to sever ties, says Egyptian forces were moved to the Libyan border, and comments on Sudan, Lebanon and the Baader-Meinhof gang. It contains no specific Tripoli sites, but it does show the regime's rhetoric and foreign policy.

summary: An FBIS transcript of an excerpted Qadhdhafi rally speech, broadcast from Tripoli on 2 September 1976, in which he describes the planned General People's Congress, rejects constitutions, presidents and a traditional army, and calls for the whole people to defend the country. It names no specific Tripoli sites, prisons or casualties.

facts: Speech says the General People's Congress will meet before next May and will select ministers-equivalent citizens for agriculture, industry, foreign affairs, interior affairs and other sectors.
Speaker says the Koran must be the source of all legislation.
Speaker says the responsibility for defence belongs to all the people rather than a traditional military, which he calls a worn-out theory.
Speech marks the seventh anniversary of the first stage of the revolution (1 September 1969).
quote: WE DO NOT HAVE LEADERS, COMMANDERS, PRESIDENTS, IDOLS, OR PEOPLE LINING UP IN COLUMN AFTER COLUMN TO CAST THEIR VOTES FOR THE PRESIDENT.

facts: Qadhafi called the failed 22 August 1976 hijacking of an Egyptian domestic flight between Cairo and Luxor 'perhaps the biggest put-up job'.
Qadhafi said he was prepared to meet Sadat for no more than five hours, without mediators, in a neutral country.
Qadhafi said one condition for better Egypt-Libya relations was the extradition of Mehishi.
Qadhafi said Italy is Libya's leading trade partner and that ENI is the only foreign oil company with a fifty-percent contract.
Libyan domestic radio reported on 25 September 1976 that Egypt had decided to abrogate trade agreements with India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh and Albania as of 1 January 1977.
quote: Basically I don't hate As-Sadat, I shall never tire of offering him my hand, but this gesture of mine should not be seen as weakness, Libya. fears-no'one.

summary: A October 1976 CIA digest of Libyan and regional news: Qadhdhafi's speech at Darna inaugurating a power station and praising the POLISARIO and Saharan Democratic Arab Republic leaders, plus Sudanese and Israeli items. Nothing specific to Tripoli itself.

facts: Qadhdhafi's speech was broadcast by Tripoli Domestic Service on 15 October 1976 and lasted 24 minutes.
Libya planned to link all Libyan cities and villages into a single power network, according to the speech.
Jallud received a French presidential emissary in Tripoli on 16 October 1976 who carried a message from Giscard d'Estaing.
Qadhdhafi visited the Central African Republic on 17 October 1976 (noted, not detailed).
